name: Terrarium 80x50x50
label: Large terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 80x50x50 cm. Volume: 200.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: An 80x50 cm floor has 4000 cm², the same as the 100x40 model, but in a shorter and wider shape. The height is 50 cm and the volume 200 liters. It has no 3D background, so the whole half meter of depth is usable. The front has sliding glass, and the other sides are covered with film on the outside.

An adult corn snake and a ball python get a wide floor for large hides and height for branches. For tortoises, the 50 cm width allows movement in a circle. Although the area is the same as the 100x40, a bearded dragon needs a length of at least 100 cm for running and for the gradient, so for it this model is only a transitional solution while it is young.

The same 50x50 cm cross-section exists in lengths of 90 and 100 cm. Taller models with the same floor are the 80x50x60 and the 80x50x80 with an aquarium. You choose the outer film from 34 patterns. We build it to order in 7 to 14 days and ship by courier anywhere in Serbia.
